ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ اَضَلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Allah has caused the works of those who disbelieve and hinder people from the way of Allah to go to waste.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ اٰمَنُوْا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَیِّاٰتِهِمْ وَ اَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: As for those who attained to faith and did righteous works and believed in what was revealed to Muhammad -- which indeed is the Truth from their Lord -- Allah has remitted their evil deeds and has set their condition right.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَ اَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ یَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمْثَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That is because those who disbelieved followed falsehood whereas those who believed followed the Truth that came to them from their Lord. Thus does Allah set forth to people parables showing their true state.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا لَقِیْتُمُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ١ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَثْخَنْتُمُوْهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثَاقَ١ۙۗ فَاِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَ اِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتّٰى تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ اَوْزَارَهَا١ۛ۫ۚ۬ ذٰؔلِكَ١ۛؕ وَ لَوْ یَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ لِّیَبْلُوَاۡ بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ قُتِلُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَنْ یُّضِلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: When you meet the unbelievers (in battle), smite their necks until you have crushed them, then bind your captives firmly; thereafter (you are entitled to) set them free, either by an act of grace, or against ransom, until the war ends. That is for you to do. If Allah had so willed, He would have Himself exacted retribution from them. (But He did not do so) that He may test some of you by means of others. As for those who are slain in the way of Allah, He shall never let their works go to waste.

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَهْدِیْهِمْ وَ یُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: He will guide them and set their condition right

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: and will admit them to Paradise with which He has acquainted them.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللّٰهَ یَنْصُرْكُمْ وَ یُثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: Believers, if you aid Allah, He will come to your aid and will plant your feet firmly.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَ اَضَلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: As to those who disbelieve, perdition lies in store for them and Allah has reduced their works to nought.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْا مَاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That was because they were averse to what Allah had revealed; so He let their works go to waste.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَیَنْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ دَمَّرَ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْهِمْ١٘ وَ لِلْكٰفِرِیْنَ اَمْثَالُهَا
ayahs.translation: Have they not journeyed through the land to see the end of those who went before them? Allah utterly destroyed them. These unbelievers are doomed to the same end.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ اَنَّ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ لَا مَوْلٰى لَهُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is because Allah is the Protector of the believers whereas the unbelievers have none to protect them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یُدْخِلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا یَتَمَتَّعُوْنَ وَ یَاْكُلُوْنَ كَمَا تَاْكُلُ الْاَنْعَامُ وَ النَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Allah shall admit those who believe and do righteous works to the Gardens beneath which rivers flow. As for the unbelievers, they enjoy the pleasures of this transient life and eat as cattle eat. The Fire shall be their resort.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَاَیِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْیَةٍ هِیَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنْ قَرْیَتِكَ الَّتِیْۤ اَخْرَجَتْكَ١ۚ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), how many are the cities that had greater power than your city that drove you out? We destroyed them and there was none to protect them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ كَمَنْ زُیِّنَ لَهٗ سُوْٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Then, can he, who is on a Clear Guidance from His Lord, be like him whose evil deeds have been embellished to him, and who pursued their lusts?

ayahs.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِیْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ١ؕ فِیْهَاۤ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ مَّآءٍ غَیْرِ اٰسِنٍ١ۚ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ یَتَغَیَّرْ طَعْمُهٗ١ۚ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشّٰرِبِیْنَ١ۚ۬ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى١ؕ وَ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَ مَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ؕ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِی النَّارِ وَ سُقُوْا مَآءً حَمِیْمًا فَقَطَّعَ اَمْعَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Here is the parable of Paradise which the God-fearing have been promised: in it shall be rivers of incorruptible water, rivers of milk unchanging in taste, and rivers of wine, a delight to those that drink; and rivers of pure honey. In it they will have every kind of fruit as well as forgiveness from their Lord. Can such be like those who will abide in the Fire and will be given a boiling water to drink that will tear their bowels apart?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ یَّسْتَمِعُ اِلَیْكَ١ۚ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا خَرَجُوْا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ مَا ذَا قَالَ اٰنِفًا١۫ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Among them some give ear to you. But no sooner do they leave your presence than they ask those endowed with knowledge: “What is it that he said just now?” Such are those whose hearts Allah has sealed and who pursue their lusts.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَّ اٰتٰىهُمْ تَقْوٰىهُمْ
ayahs.translation: As for those who were led to the Guidance, Allah increases them in their guidance and causes them to grow in God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَهَلْ یَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنْ تَاْتِیَهُمْ بَغْتَةً١ۚ فَقَدْ جَآءَ اَشْرَاطُهَا١ۚ فَاَنّٰى لَهُمْ اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرٰىهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Are they waiting, then, for anything else than the Last Hour to suddenly come upon them? Already some of its tokens have come. But when it does actually come upon them, where will any time be left for them to take heed?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْۢبِكَ وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَ مَثْوٰىكُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Know, therefore, (O Prophet), that there is no god but Allah, and ask forgiveness for your shortcomings and also for (the shortcomings of) believing men and believing women. Allah knows the places where you move about and where you dwell.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ لَا نُزِّلَتْ سُوْرَةٌ١ۚ فَاِذَاۤ اُنْزِلَتْ سُوْرَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَّ ذُكِرَ فِیْهَا الْقِتَالُ١ۙ رَاَیْتَ الَّذِیْنَ فِیْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ یَّنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَیْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِیِّ عَلَیْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ١ؕ فَاَوْلٰى لَهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: The believers used to say: “Why is a surah (that would ordain fighting) not revealed?” But when a definitive surah was revealed wherein fighting was mentioned, you saw that those in whose hearts there was a sickness looked at you as though they were about to faint at the approach of death. Pity on them!

ayahs.arabicText: طَاعَةٌ وَّ قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوْفٌ١۫ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الْاَمْرُ١۫ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللّٰهَ لَكَانَ خَیْرًا لَّهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: (They keep affirming their) obedience and saying good words. But when a course of action was clearly determined, it would have been better for them if they had proved true to Allah.

ayahs.arabicText: فَهَلْ عَسَیْتُمْ اِنْ تَوَلَّیْتُمْ اَنْ تُفْسِدُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ تُقَطِّعُوْۤا اَرْحَامَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: Now, if you were to turn away, what else can be expected but that you will work corruption in the land and fly at each other's throats?

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمْ وَ اَعْمٰۤى اَبْصَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: It is these upon whom Allah has laid His curse: so He made them deaf and deprived them of their sight.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَا یَتَدَبَّرُوْنَ الْقُرْاٰنَ اَمْ عَلٰى قُلُوْبٍ اَقْفَالُهَا
ayahs.translation: Do they, then, not reflect on the Qur'an? Or are there locks on their hearts?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ ارْتَدُّوْا عَلٰۤى اَدْبَارِهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى١ۙ الشَّیْطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اَمْلٰى لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Certainly those who have turned their backs on the True Guidance after it became manifest to them, Satan has embellished their ways for them and has buoyed them up with false hopes.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ كَرِهُوْا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ سَنُطِیْعُكُمْ فِیْ بَعْضِ الْاَمْرِ١ۖۚ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ اِسْرَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: This, because they said to those who are averse to the faith that Allah has revealed: “In some matters we shall obey you.” Allah has full knowledge of their secret parleys.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ یَضْرِبُوْنَ وُجُوْهَهُمْ وَ اَدْبَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: But how will they fare when angels will take their souls at death and will carry them, striking their faces and backs?

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْا مَاۤ اَسْخَطَ اللّٰهَ وَ كَرِهُوْا رِضْوَانَهٗ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is because they have followed a way that angered Allah, and have been averse to His good pleasure. So He reduced all their works to nought.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِیْنَ فِیْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ اَنْ لَّنْ یُّخْرِجَ اللّٰهُ اَضْغَانَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Or do they, in whose hearts there is a sickness, believe that Allah will not bring their failings to light?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَاَرَیْنٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِیْمٰىهُمْ١ؕ وَ لَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِیْ لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: If We were to so will, We could have shown them to you so that you would recognise them by their faces, and you would certainly know them by the manner of their speech. Allah knows all your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰى نَعْلَمَ الْمُجٰهِدِیْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ١ۙ وَ نَبْلُوَاۡ اَخْبَارَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: We shall certainly test you until We know those of you who truly strive and remain steadfast, and will ascertain about you.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ شَآقُّوا الرَّسُوْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدٰى١ۙ لَنْ یَّضُرُّوا اللّٰهَ شَیْئًا١ؕ وَ سَیُحْبِطُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah's Way and opposed the Messenger after the True Guidance had become manifest to them, they shall not be able to cause Allah the least harm; rather, Allah will reduce all their works to nought.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اَطِیْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوا الرَّسُوْلَ وَ لَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: Believers, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not cause your works to be nullified.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْا وَ هُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ یَّغْفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Verily Allah shall not forgive those who disbelieved and barred others from Allah's Way and clung to their unbelief until their death.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَهِنُوْا وَ تَدْعُوْۤا اِلَى السَّلْمِ١ۖۗ وَ اَنْتُمُ الْاَعْلَوْنَ١ۖۗ وَ اللّٰهُ مَعَكُمْ وَ لَنْ یَّتِرَكُمْ اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: So, be not faint-hearted and do not cry for peace. You shall prevail. Allah is with you and will not bring your works to nought.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَا لَعِبٌ وَّ لَهْوٌ١ؕ وَ اِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا یُؤْتِكُمْ اُجُوْرَكُمْ وَ لَا یَسْئَلْكُمْ اَمْوَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: The life of this world is but sport and amusement. If you believe and are God-fearing, He will grant you your reward, and will not ask you for your possessions.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ یَّسْئَلْكُمُوْهَا فَیُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْا وَ یُخْرِجْ اَضْغَانَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: If He were to ask you for your possessions and press you (in that regard), you would have grown niggardly, and Allah would have brought your failings to light.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰۤاَنْتُمْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ١ۚ فَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ یَّبْخَلُ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّبْخَلْ فَاِنَّمَا یَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَّفْسِهٖ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ الْغَنِیُّ وَ اَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَآءُ١ۚ وَ اِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا یَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَیْرَكُمْ١ۙ ثُمَّ لَا یَكُوْنُوْۤا اَمْثَالَكُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Behold, you are those who are called upon to spend in Allah's Way, but some of you are niggardly. Whoever is niggardly is in fact niggardly to himself. For Allah is All-Sufficient, whereas it is you who are in need of Him. If you turn away, He will replace you by a people other than you, and they will not be like you.
